fields.description: The address of the return line and the footer. Without one, the primary address of the company.
fields.label: Address of the Company

fields.description: DIN 5008 form B puts the address field 45 mm from the top, form A 27 mm. Both fit window envelopes C5/6, DL and C4.
fields.label: Letter Form

fields.description: On blank paper the printouts bring the letterhead and the footer with the particulars of the company. On pre-printed paper they leave both blank.
fields.label: Paper

fields.description: Printed in the letterhead on blank paper at the height below and as wide as its proportions ask, at most 75 mm: PNG, JPEG or SVG.
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: The company in one line above the address of the recipient, as the window of the envelope shows it.
fields.label: Print Return Address

fields.description: The look of the printouts in the corporate design of the company, without changing a template.
fields.label: Theme

fields.description: For the heads of the tables and the rules. Empty: black.
fields.label: Accent Colour

fields.description: Inter comes with Briefbote and prints the same on every server; the system font is the sans-serif font of the server.
fields.label: Font

fields.description: At most up to 4 mm above the address field.
fields.label: Logo Height (mm)

fields.description: Which blocks the footer shows in which column. Empty: four columns, company, register, tax numbers, bank.
fields.label: Footer

fields.description: What a business letter must state about the company: Section 35a GmbHG, Section 80 AktG, Sections 37a and 125 HGB.
fields.label: Particulars of the Company

fields.description: For example: Amtsgericht Musterstadt
fields.label: Register Court

fields.description: For example: HRB 12345
fields.label: Register Number

fields.description: The Steuernummer of the tax office. The USt-IdNr. comes from the company.
fields.label: Tax Number

fields.description: One per line, with family name and at least one first name written out.
fields.label: Managing Directors

fields.description: For an AG: one member per line; mark the chair as such.
fields.label: Executive Board

fields.description: Printed in the footer and named in the payment request of an invoice.
fields.label: Bank Accounts

fields.description: The hours an invoice bills from its timesheets, entry by entry.
fields.label: Timesheet Annex

fields.description: With the invoice: on its own pages after the invoice. Separate document: with the print format Leistungsnachweis.
fields.label: Print the Timesheet Annex
fields.options:
With the invoice
Separate document
Not printed

fields.description: The unit of the positions the invoice bills by time, such as Hour; their quantity must equal the hours of the annex. Empty: no positions are compared.
fields.label: Unit of Time

fields.description: Unit prices, amounts and totals on the Lieferschein; a Delivery Note with Print Without Amount prints none.
fields.label: Print Prices on Delivery Notes

fields.description: Lines for date, signature and name of the recipient below the positions.
fields.label: Print a Receipt to Sign

fields.description: The base rate of Section 247 BGB as the Bundesbank publishes it for each 1 January and 1 July. Dunning letters check their interest against it.
fields.label: Base Rates

fields.description: Title, text and days to pay of a level, where the defaults do not fit. {deadline} in the text stands for the day to pay by.
fields.label: Dunning Levels

fields.description: The company charges no VAT under Section 19 UStG; every invoice says so.
fields.label: Small Business (Section 19 UStG)

fields.description: The tax case of each sales tax template, which decides the notices of an invoice. A template without a row is a supply taxable in Germany.
fields.label: Tax Cases

fields.description: The tax case of each purchase tax template, which decides the notices of a self-billing invoice (Gutschrift). A template without a row is a supply taxable in Germany.
fields.label: Purchase Tax Cases
